summary: SvelteKit relay now forwards the visitor's browser User-Agent (X-BottleCRM-User-Agent, only alongside the relay secret) and the API records it in audit logs and on public estimate acceptance instead of the server's own axios UA; bundled with an unmentioned magic-link change: opening the emailed sign-in link no longer signs you in, the user must press a 'Continue to BottleCRM' button (POST) so mail scanners can't burn the one-time token.

statements.text: Nothing flagged — plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.
statements.why: The login flow changed, but it's a hardening (token spent only by a POST button, not by scanners' GET); no login hole, payment, schema or secret problem.

statements.text: • The login verify page now sends data to your server and says "Sign in · BottleCRM" and "Press the button to finish signing in.". /login/verify
statements.why: login/verify/+page.svelte: title 'Sign in · BottleCRM', new POST form with 'Press the button to finish signing in.'; conveys the extra click, though not why (mail scanners burning the one-time link).

statements.text: • The login page changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /login
statements.why: login/+page.server.js now passes the request so the visitor's User-Agent is relayed for the audit row; true but unexplained.

statements.text: + New server code that accepts requests. /login/verify
statements.why: New default form action in login/verify/+page.server.js that spends the magic-link token and sets JWT cookies.

statements.text: • The agent changed the public estimate accept, login, org, org new, portal estimate and portal login parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: All of these now relay the visitor UA (public_views.py stores accepted_user_agent; frontend routes pass request to relayHeaders); accurate but unexplained.

statements.text: • The agent also changed backend/common/audit_log.py and backend/common/request_meta.py, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: New user_agent() helper reads the relayed X-BottleCRM-User-Agent; true but unexplained.

statements.text: • The agent also changed backend/common/tests/test_audit_log.py, backend/common/tests/test_request_meta.py and backend/invoices/tests/test_invoices_api.py (tests).
plain can't tell which pages the login check in frontend/src/hooks.server.* covers, so it doesn't say whether the new or changed pages and server code here need login. Check they're behind it.
statements.why: The changed pages here are the sign-in pages (/login, /login/verify, portal login) and the public estimate accept, which must stay open to signed-out visitors; telling the owner to put them behind login is wrong advice for this commit.
